resolved_findings.resolution: The single original manifest byte object supplies both parsed proposals and receipt hash. An exact end-of-run byte equality guard rejects mutation before publishing the receipt.

checks: Native guarded writer is invoked with explicit IngredientRecord class for every exact candidate.
Each source after hash is checked before writing; original source hash is checked again after the private replay.
Destination is formed only within a fresh UUID private run directory from a hashed proposal ID; no maintained destination is used.
Parsed replay YAML must equal the input record, permitting formatter byte changes without scientific content changes.
The replay helper and receipt are explicit hashed native inputs.
The other five v4-bound scripts are byte-identical, including assembler/control helper and severity correction.

controls.method: Exact final freshness-assert AST executed with isolated read_bytes stub; no file mutation
Exact final freshness-assert AST executed with isolated read_bytes stub; no file mutation

limitations: Static helper/source review plus two executed isolated freshness controls; the full125-candidate replay must actually run before its PASS may be reported.
This gate tests closed-schema writing and logical roundtrip, not scientific validity, downstream rebuild or publication approval.
v2/v4 controls remain applicable to their unchanged relevant code. Final canonical/native/staged checks are separate.
